reuse.why: Moving logic (holidays) is folded into the existing getDateWithWeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the new isWeekendOrHoliday predicate is shared, but the daily-skip rule is not put behind the shared helper and each caller handles it itself.

duplication.why: The 'daily + skipWeekend: iterate occurrences, drop weekend/holiday ones' logic is written three times (getNextDate's findWeekdayOccurrence, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange), holiday Set construction is repeated, and schedule-template's duplicated nextDate ternary grows further.

placement.why: Holiday/weekend predicates live in shared/schedules, but the daily rule is decided by frequency checks scattered across server/schedules/app.ts and budget/schedule-template.ts rather than in the shared date layer.

scope.why: Changes stay within the four requested steps, plus a release note.

maintainability.why: Four separate isDaily branches (including schedule-template flipping noSkipWeekend) must stay in sync with each other and with the moving rule; a single occurrence-adjust function returning null for skipped days would remove that burden.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange daily branches, and budget/schedule-template.ts isDaily toggle, decide the daily skip outside getDateWithWeekendRule/getNextDate

disguised_duplication.where: Daily weekend-skip iteration reshaped as findWeekdayOccurrence (shared/schedules.ts getNextDate), a push loop in getUpcomingDates and a continue branch in getDatesInRange

abstraction_drift.where: holidays added to getDateWithSkippedWeekend and getDateWithWeekendRule; daily special case branch inside getNextDate; getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template re-implement or bypass the daily rule
